items.q: That was when I worked with the two Ethels

ctx.x: place at Kentucky and Arctic Avenue. And then he was just turning his place over to another MAN called Charley, um, anyhow this fellow was Charley, I can't think of Charley's name, but, anyhow, this fellow was a very good friend. And I worked a season there. That was when I worked with the two Ethels and there was a fellow named Snow Fisher, he was a great strutter, and a girl named Izzy Ringgold was a great dancer, come from a dancing family.
Okay, now, the two Ethels were Ethel Waters and Ethel White.
